description: This file is a shell script used for controlling system LEDs on an embedded device, providing functions to get LED identifiers and set LED states based on system status.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the filename of the status power LED.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the filename of the failsafe fault LED.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided system state such as preinit, failsafe, or done.
